title: Jab koi dua aur na dawa
body:
Jab koi dua aur na dawa
Jab koi dua aur na dawa kaam karegi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ke parcham ki hawa kaam karegi
1. Aksar ye ali kehte the ghaazi ko uthakar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra ki dua sab se juda kaam karegi
2. Ab chaand ka kya kaam raha ghar me ali ke..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maahe bani hashim ki ziya kaam karegi
3. Khud denge shehenshah e wafa usko salami..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch is tarah fizza ki wafa kaam karegi
4. Shabbir ke roze se kafan leke chala hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab meri hifazat ka qaza kaam karegi
5. Fir bhi nahi utrega khadija tera qarza..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Din raat bhi gar khalq e khuda kaam karegi
6. Shabbir ka sar hai ye kahi jhuk nahi sakta..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Naize ki ani par bhi ana kaam karegi
7. Ye haaziri ye hazrat e abbas hai sajjad..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Qismat se ziyada ye ghiza kaam karegi
author: Mir Hassan Mir
